name: Jan Kolář
bio:
Jan Kolář's journey in motorsport began with a childhood obsession with Škodas rallying through the Czech countryside. He started his career as a junior mechanic, quickly demonstrating an aptitude for understanding vehicle dynamics and race strategy. He moved into team management, first at smaller national outfits, then gradually climbing the ladder to Century Motorsport.

As a sporting director, Jan focuses on nurturing talent from within the team and creating a collaborative environment between engineers and drivers. He believes in data-driven decision-making, but also trusts his gut instinct honed through years of experience. His distinctive approach involves actively seeking out alternative strategies, often pushing the boundaries of conventional wisdom to gain a competitive edge. He is known for his keen eye for talent and his ability to motivate his team to achieve ambitious goals.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Jan is a lean man of average height with a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas, even during races.
Has a collection of vintage rally posters in his office.
Insists on a team lunch every Friday to foster camaraderie.
